CHANNEL_GREETING_MODE.LABEL: When to send the channel greeting
CHANNEL_GREETING_MODE.HELP_TEXT: All four modes send one greeting only to visitors with no message history in this inbox. Existing history prevents another greeting, even after reopening the window or starting a new conversation. The first incoming message triggers message-based greetings and does not count as previous history.

OPTIONS.FIRST_OPEN: When the visitor first opens the chat window
OPTIONS.EVERY_OPEN: Every time the visitor opens the chat window
OPTIONS.EVERY_OPEN_FIRST_MESSAGE: After the first message each time the visitor opens the chat window
OPTIONS.FIRST_MESSAGE: After the first message in a new conversation
